2202.  Checking Whether a Number Is a Palindrome Using a Function

60

Medium

Problem Statement
Read an integer and determine whether it reads the same forward and backward, using a function that returns 1 or 0.

Description
A palindrome number is a number that is equal to its own reverse, for example 121. Read a positive integer num from input. Write a function isPalindrome that takes an integer parameter, builds the reverse of the number using a while loop (take the last digit with % 10, add it to the reverse after multiplying the reverse by 10, and remove the digit using / 10), and returns 1 if the reverse equals the original number, otherwise 0. In main(), print "Palindrome" or "Not Palindrome" based on the returned value.
input_spec:
. In main(), print "Palindrome" or "Not Palindrome" based on the returned value.

output_spec: Print "Palindrome" if num is a palindrome number, otherwise print "Not Palindrome".
